property_summary: For any depositor and deposit amount, after funding C via fallback and then calling withdraw from that depositor, the reference contract's withdraw call always returns (does not revert) and leaves c.balance == 0; the mutant using transfer can revert when the recipient's fallback consumes >2300 gas, thus causing c.balance to remain nonzero for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the call to use transfer (which reverts on failure but forwards fixed 2300 gas) instead of low-level call.
